text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
WOW! What an epiphany! Sometimes I
scare
myself with how smart I am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Combining daily cleaning with training...
This is
killing two birds with one stone
AT ITS FINEST!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now I just need to think about how to
do it!
Hmmm, how can I clean in a way
that'll boost my
Bakushin?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, you! Do you have any
suggestions?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed?! You mean wiping the floor will
lead me
to even greater Bakushin
speed?!
choice_data_list: 雑巾がけで、スピード強化！
資料室の整理で、パワーも強化！
choice_data_list_en: Boost your speed by scrubbing the floors!
Organizing the reference room boosted Power too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a fantastic idea! I'll get on that
right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! So if I Bakushin while I tidy stuff,
it'll lead
me to having an even more
powerful Bakushin?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Raaaah! Leave it to me! Making things
nice and
tidy is a piece of cake for a
genius like me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A series of truly frightening noises
follows in
Sakura Bakushin O's wake, but
at least it looks
like her problem's solved
now.
